sequence.cn: 简单来说，就是"靠脸、靠才艺、靠搞笑吃饭的人"。
sequence.py: Jiǎndān lái shuō, jiùshì "kào liǎn, kào cáiyì, kào gǎoxiào chīfàn de rén".
sequence.en: Simply put, it's someone who makes a living through looks, talent, or humor.

sequence.cn: 不过现在连猫和狗都能当网红，所以……你还有什么借口？
sequence.py: Búguò xiànzài lián māo hé gǒu dōu néng dāng wǎng hóng, suǒyǐ…… nǐ hái yǒu shénme jièkǒu?
sequence.en: But these days even cats and dogs can become 网红, so… what's your excuse?

sequence.py: Xiǎo Lǐ jiùshì zhèyàng xiǎng de.
sequence.en: Xiao Li thought exactly this way.

sequence.cn: 有一天他突然宣布："我要当网红！"
sequence.py: Yǒu yītiān tā tūrán xuānbù: "Wǒ yào dāng wǎng hóng!"
sequence.en: One day he suddenly announced: "I want to be a 网红!"

sequence.cn: 朋友问他打算做什么内容，他想了三秒说："还没想好，但我已经买了三个补光灯。"
sequence.py: Péngyou wèn tā dǎsuàn zuò shénme nèiróng, tā xiǎngle sān miǎo shuō: "Hái méi xiǎng hǎo, dàn wǒ yǐjīng mǎile sān gè bǔguāng dēng."
sequence.en: His friend asked what content he planned. He thought 3 seconds: "Haven't decided, but I already bought three ring lights."

sequence.cn: 结果……他的猫因为坐在补光灯前睡觉，意外走红，现在有五十万粉丝。
sequence.py: Jiéguǒ…… tā de māo yīnwèi zuò zài bǔguāng dēng qián shuìjiào, yìwài zǒu hóng, xiànzài yǒu wǔshí wàn fěnsī.
sequence.en: The result: his cat went viral from sleeping in front of the ring lights, now with 500K followers.

sequence.cn: 小李每天帮猫拍视频、剪视频，成了全职猫奴。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Lǐ měitiān bāng māo pāi shìpín, jiǎn shìpín, chéngle quánzhí māonú.
sequence.en: Xiao Li films and edits for the cat every day — he became a full-time cat servant.

sequence.cn: 所以说，成为网红的秘诀到底是颜值还是努力？都不是——是你家有没有一只有缘分的猫。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ shuō, chénwéi wǎng hóng de mìjué dàodǐ shì yánzhí háishi nǔlì? Dōu bùshì—— shì nǐ jiā yǒu méiyǒu yī zhī yǒu yuánfèn de māo.
sequence.en: So, the real secret to becoming a 网红 — looks or hard work? Neither. It's whether your cat has destiny.
